function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT d.name
FROM Dogs d
WHERE d.owner_id IN (
  SELECT o.owner_id
  FROM Owners o
  LEFT JOIN Dogs d2 ON d2.owner_id = o.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON t.dog_id = d2.dog_id
  GROUP BY o.owner_id
  HAVING COALESCE(SUM(t.cost_of_treatment),0) <= 1000
);"}
function.name: run_sql
